entities.name: Adversary War
entities.description: Conflict on Capenna in 4562 AR in which Ob Nixilis tried to overthrow New Capenna's five crime families.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Planeswalker who attempted to seize New Capenna.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane and city attacked by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: The Cabaretti's annual New Year celebration, site of the coordinated strike.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Substance Ob Nixilis offered in exchange for loyalty.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: Leader of the Maestros, killed by Ob Nixilis at the Maestro Museum.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: Crime family led by Xander.

entities.name: Maestro Museum
entities.description: Where Nixilis killed Xander.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Xander's deputy, who took control of the Maestros.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: Crime family struck by the Adversary's agents.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: Cabaretti leader, gravely wounded.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's adopted daughter.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Crime family with a safehouse that sheltered Jetmir.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Young woman with the power to create pure Halo.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who rescued Giada and wounded Nixilis.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who rescued Giada.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: District with a cathedral where the battle occurred.

entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: Infused sword given to Elspeth by Giada.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group on Dominaria Elspeth and Vivien went to warn.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Past enemy of the plane.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Elspeth and Vivien departed for.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis infiltrates the crime families by offering Halo in exchange for loyalty.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis infiltrated the city's families by offering Halo in exchange for loyalty

events.summary: Nixilis kills Xander at the Maestro Museum, leaving the Maestros to Anhelo.
events.quote: killing him and leaving control of the Maestros to his deputy

events.summary: Agents of the Adversary strike the Cabaretti at the Crescendo; Jetmir is gravely wounded and taken to an Obscura safehouse by Jinnie Fay.
events.quote: Their leader, Jetmir , was gravely wounded

events.summary: Giada is revealed to be the Font and becomes a primary target.
events.quote: was revealed to be "the Font" and became a primary target

events.summary: Elspeth and Vivien rescue Giada and take her to a cathedral in Park Heights, pursued by Nixilis.
events.quote: Giada was rescued by Elspeth Tirel and Vivien Reid

events.summary: Giada sacrifices herself, becoming Halo and giving Elspeth the sword Luxior.
events.quote: Giada sacrificed herself, transforming into Halo

events.summary: Elspeth seriously wounds Nixilis, forcing him to planeswalk away.
events.quote: Elspeth dealt Nixilis a serious wound, forcing him to planeswalk away.

events.summary: Giada's sacrifice breaks the stasis of New Capenna's angels.
events.quote: allowing them to return to the city

events.summary: Elspeth and Vivien access Xander's archives and learn of the plane's conflict with the Phyrexians, then depart for Dominaria to warn the Gatewatch.
events.quote: They departed for Dominaria to warn the Gatewatch

relations.quote: Nixilis personally confronted Xander at the Maestro Museum, killing him
Giada was rescued by Elspeth Tirel and Vivien Reid
Elspeth dealt Nixilis a serious wound
